scope: Daily Wiki (每日图片) Swiss header: a two-tone title wordmark whose blue slash echoes the date rail's slash, and a shape strip that fills the empty header gap between the title and the date.
rendering: Both assets hold only black ink and cobalt accent (#0052ff). swiss_renderer.two_tone_artwork reads the blue channel as the accent share and repaints the artwork with the palette's ink and accent, so night mode keeps the same shapes in white and light blue. The strip is drawn with crisp px(2) rules out to the title and the date on its axis.
post_processing: The generator added a soft blue glow in alpha: alpha is remapped linearly from 48..224 to 0..255, and colour is snapped to black or #0052ff (blended only across a 0.4..0.6 blue share). The wordmark is cropped to its alpha bounds with an 8px pad. The strip drops its thin end rules and is cropped symmetrically about their axis (y=362.5 in the 2112x704 source), so the axis is the asset's vertical centre.
